login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Jube account to continue.

mfa.title: Verify it is you
mfa.intro: Enter the code from your security token to finish signing in.
mfa.label: Verification code
mfa.hint: Digits only, exactly as your token shows them.

change.title: Choose a new password
change.intro: Your password must be changed before you can continue. The new password replaces the old one for every future sign-in.

rules.title: Your new password needs
rules.repeat: No character repeated more than twice in a row
rules.common: Not starting with a common pattern such as 123456

errors.invalid: The details were not accepted. Check them and try again.
errors.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
errors.weak: The new password does not meet every requirement.
errors.rejected: The server did not accept the request.
errors.unavailable: Jube could not be reached. Try again in a moment.

login.redirecting: Taking you to your organisation’s sign-in…
login.negotiateFailed: Your computer did not sign you in automatically, and this installation does not accept a password. Check you are signed in to your organisation’s network, then try again.

shell.signOutFailed: Sign-out failed. Check your connection and try again.
shell.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
shell.sessionWarning: Your session is about to expire.
shell.tenantMore: Showing the first {count}. Keep typing to narrow the list.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.labelUnread: no notifications | one unread notification | {count} unread notifications
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing new. Notifications will appear here once the notification service is connected.

errors.forbidden: You are not permitted to do that.
errors.conflict: That record changed. Reload it and try again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
errors.notFound: That record could not be found.
errors.server: The server could not complete the request.

permissions.choose: Pick a role to see and change its permissions.
permissions.loadFailed: The permissions could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
